answer.answer:
AAPL's reported revenue series holds 339 points, all in the SOURCE_REPORTED state. The earliest period covered is the fiscal year 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29, reported in two observations from different filings that disagree: 24,006,000,000 USD (10-K, accession 0001193125-09-214859) and 24,578,000,000 USD (10-K/A, accession 0001193125-10-012091). The latest period covered is 2025-09-28 to 2026-06-27, reported at 364,357,000,000 USD from 10-Q accession 0000320193-26-000020, and the most recent single-quarter point in the series is 2026-03-29 to 2026-06-27 at 109,417,000,000 USD. The total number of points is 339, which is the figure reported as total_count by every page of the cursor walk and independently corroborated by the asset coverage report, which shows 339 observations held for revenue in the SOURCE_REPORTED state.

Two qualifications on how this series may be read. First, 339 is a count of reported observations, not a count of distinct fiscal periods: the same period is frequently reported by several filings, so a single period can occupy multiple points, as the 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 period does. Second, the series is not uniform in concept fidelity across its span. The early portion, from 2007-09-29 to 2018-06-30, is mapped from us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet with a PARTIAL mapping that the registry records as a series break, and a us-gaap:Revenues window from 2016-09-24 to 2018-09-29 carries a second PARTIAL break. The latest point, from 2017-09-30 onward, is mapped from us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax with an EXACT mapping and series_continues true. The series-level comparability flag is a single us-gaap reporting framework, marked comparable, but that flag speaks to framework and not to concept fidelity, which varies by window as described.

Finally, the series I walked is the paginated observation set. The history endpoint returns 200 of 339 points and is itself truncated, so it is not a complete rendering of the series; the earliest and latest periods and the 339 total above are taken from the paginated walk and the coverage report rather than from that truncated history response.
uncertainties: The earliest period 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 is reported with two different values (24,006,000,000 and 24,578,000,000 USD) by two filings, and ST-EVA has selected no winner; the disagreement is unresolved in the evidence held.
The period 2007-09-30 to 2008-09-27 is likewise reported with two different values (32,479,000,000 and 37,491,000,000 USD) across three filings, with no winner selected.
The count of 339 is a count of observations, not of distinct fiscal periods; the number of distinct periods in the span is not established by the evidence returned.

Concept fidelity differs across the series: PARTIAL mappings govern the earlier windows and an EXACT mapping governs from 2017-09-30, so points in different windows are not on an identical basis even though the framework is us-gaap throughout.
The series breaks recorded against the SalesRevenueNet and Revenues mappings are annotated NOT_EXPLAINED_BY_ST_EVA, so the evidence does not state why the series must break at those windows.

The full 339-point series was not inspected point by point; the intermediate 139 points between the 200 returned by the history endpoint and the total were covered only through the paginated walk and its stated total_count, not individually read.
